title: Quiz 1 — Chemical Reactions in Everyday Lives

questions.text: What is a chemical reaction?
options: A process where reactants change into new products with different properties
A physical change like melting ice
questions.correct: A process where reactants change into new products with different properties

questions.text: In a chemical equation, what does the arrow (→) mean?
Which of the following is NOT a sign of a chemical reaction?
options: Change in shape without any other change
questions.correct: Change in shape without any other change

questions.text: What type of reaction occurs when hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) breaks down into water and oxygen?
Vinegar reacting with baking soda to produce fizzing is an example of:
What gas is released when an acid reacts with a metal?
What gas is released when an acid reacts with a carbonate (like baking soda)?
Burning LPG in a stove is an example of what type of reaction?
What are the products of complete combustion of a hydrocarbon fuel?
Why should you NEVER mix bleach with ammonia cleaner?
options: It releases toxic chloramine gas that can damage lungs
questions.correct: It releases toxic chloramine gas that can damage lungs

questions.text: Which equation correctly represents photosynthesis?
Which equation correctly represents cellular respiration?
Why must a chemical equation be balanced?
options: Because of the Law of Conservation of Mass — atoms are neither created nor destroyed
questions.correct: Because of the Law of Conservation of Mass — atoms are neither created nor destroyed

questions.text: What is a coefficient in a chemical equation?
options: A whole number placed in front of a chemical formula to balance the equation
A subscript showing the number of atoms
questions.correct: A whole number placed in front of a chemical formula to balance the equation

questions.text: Where in the cell does cellular respiration mainly occur?
What is ATP and why is it important?
options: It is the energy currency of the cell — used for cellular work
It is a type of sugar
It is a protein for growth
questions.correct: It is the energy currency of the cell — used for cellular work

questions.text: Why are photosynthesis and respiration considered 'opposite reactions'?
options: Their reactants and products are reversed
They happen in the same organelle
questions.correct: Their reactants and products are reversed

questions.text: Balance this equation: __ H₂ + O₂ → __ H₂O. What are the correct coefficients?
After eating rice, your body breaks down the starch into glucose. This is an example of:
options: Catabolism — breaking down larger molecules to release energy
questions.correct: Catabolism — breaking down larger molecules to release energy

questions.text: Rusting of iron is best described as:
options: Slow oxidation — iron reacts with oxygen and water to form iron oxide
questions.correct: Slow oxidation — iron reacts with oxygen and water to form iron oxide
